nodes.name: tree-doc
nodes.body: The renderer bullet now tells future sessions where the Change Stack outline lives: stacktree.ts derives it, StackTree.tsx renders it.

nodes.name: scars
nodes.summary: Two scars join the gotcha list
nodes.body: Chromium's UA stylesheet gives <button> align-items: flex-start, so ellipsis on a column-flex button's children never fires without an explicit stretch; and app.css is one global sheet where the later equal-specificity rule wins — the .tree-row collision zeroed the outline's guide lines while restyling the file tree. The CLAUDE.md tree-view sentence gains the grep-before-naming rule, which is why this change builds on it.

nodes.name: shot-evidence
nodes.summary: The shot carries its own evidence
nodes.body: Document the computed-style probe: a drive script can append a <pre> of getComputedStyle/clientWidth/scrollWidth readings to the DOM so the numbers land inside the capture — vitest is layout-blind and a picture alone can lie at a different pane width.
